newsitem.title: UK: LIFFE white sugar touch weaker, but trade minimal.
newsitem.headline: LIFFE white sugar touch weaker, but trade minimal.

text.p: White sugar futures barely moved on Wednesday morning with the nearby August contract trading a tight inside range and reluctant to stray from its opening price, traders said.
August was trapped in a range of just 20 cents, standing at $312.50 by 1045 GMT and down 80 cents on the day. October was down 30 cents at $304.70.
Total volume was a paltry 70 lots.

There was little fundamental news to spur activity and traders said even the usual Wednesday pre-hedging against the European Union's weekly tender for export licences appeared to be thin on the ground.
Paris trading was confined to the spot August position, which was down 10 cents at $312.50 in volume of 67 lots.
